notes.title: Cheats & Upcoming Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]Today’s a small but useful update: we’ve added a [b]cheat option[/b]!
At the [b][u]bottom of the options menu[/u][/b], you’ll now find two settings that let you automatically win card battles.[/p][p]This feature was requested by many players who simply want to enjoy the story without worrying about the gameplay. (Totally fair—everyone plays their own way!) So now, the choice is yours.[/p][p]⚠️ Just a heads-up: in the final version of the game, using cheats will disable achievements.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Next Update News[/h3][p]The next [b]Porn and Cards[/b] update is planned for [b]early September[/b] ✅
Like the last one, it’ll be faster to produce—after all, we’re nearing the end of the journey! This time, you’ll also get to spend more time with our dear [b]Pearl ~[/b][/p][p]After that, we’ll move on to the [b]final update[/b] and then... the [b]official release of the game[/b]! 🎉
Releases are always stressful (you never really get used to it ^^), but we’re getting close![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for your support, and see you soon for the next update!
Bye ~~[/p]

notes.title: Porn and Cards: PART 3
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Hello everyone![/b][/i][b]  
[/b][i]Part 3 is here !~~[/i][b]
[/b][/h3][h3]🌠 Story Progression[/h3][p]The tale continues with part 3!  New scenes, fresh dialogue, and deeper mysteries unfold in the dusty town of Lucky Valley. [/p][h3]⚔️ New Battles & Card Units[/h3][p]Expect tougher duels and new units to command on the battlefield. Plan smart, shoot fast. [/p][h3]📜 Gallery Panels Added[/h3][p]We've added the rest of the gallery! Now you can rewatch the images you've earned, the unique music you've discovered, and the cards you've collected![/p][p]I think it looks way too good ~~[/p][h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]- More AI improvements.

- You can now sell cards AND change your equipment in-game! (Thanks to Emee) (It unlocks during the game)
- We now have a loading screen! (It's better than an old freeze when loading saves haha)
- Major change: the gallery has been improved! With the addition of the image, music, and card panels!
- In general, we've further improved the way cards are loaded in-game, so it should freeze a bit less on lower-end PCs. 
- We fixed some bugs with summons cards.
- And lots of other small fixes.

📝 And, thanks for playing and sharing your feedback ~

From this update on, the next updates will all be part of Part 4 of the game, which will be the final part before the full release and the last update. Be careful what you say, because the game has multiple possible endings, so... watch your choices!

notes.title: Porn and Cards: PART 2
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone![/i] The Part 2 is here !!
New faces, new stories, new battles, and more NSFW stuff! 🪄❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061231/caf3c8a4975c19b267226baea31d6c4182d77f10.gif[/img]

[h3]Changelog[/h3] 
What's new in town:
[h3]🌠 Story Progression[/h3]  
The tale continues with part 2! 
New scenes, fresh dialogue, and deeper mysteries unfold in the dusty town of Lucky Valley.
[h3]🤠 Two New Characters Ride In[/h3]  
Two brand-new personalities make their entrance, each with their own secrets... and temptations. (On top of the Sheriff you’ve already met.)
[h3]🔥 More NSFW Content[/h3]  
Things are getting steamier!~ New intimate scenes have been added for your… exploration.
[h3]⚔️ New Battles & Card Units[/h3]  
Expect tougher duels and new units to command on the battlefield. Plan smart, shoot fast.
[h3]📜 Quest Panel Added[/h3]  
A brand-new panel: track your progress and replay unlocked NSFW scenes whenever the mood strikes.

[h3]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
- AI now makes smarter tactical choices.  
- Special cards no longer get counted as played when they’re not.  
- Damage previews now correctly calculate movement and results, especially in tutorial missions.  
- Opponent’s HP display is now in the right place (no more floating ghost numbers).  
- UI blur effects, highlights, and transitions now behave properly across menus and scenes.  
- Cards now appear and disappear when they should—no more ghost cards stuck in your hand.  
- Inventory and menu transitions have been smoothed out.  
- Live2D animations now loop only when intended and no longer restart at random.  
- Context stack issues fixed when jumping around during combat.  
- Starting a New Game no longer gives you your old deck back from another timeline.  
- Mouse cursor now reliably appears when opening menus during animations.  
- Visual glitches with card placements, team mirroring, and spot highlights have been fixed.  
- Saving is now disabled during fights to avoid cursed save files.  
- Various animation, UI and performance fixes for a smoother ride through Lucky Valley.

📝 Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!  
This update lays the groundwork for even more stories, wild west NSFW scenes, and spicy surprises coming your way soon.

The next chapter of PnC is already in the works — stay sharp, and keep your deck ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061231/2c4b039b02f5717ef9809f4138bba0ffd3c55355.png[/img]

notes.title: Part 1 Rework Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3]

Today on Steam, for the first update of our beloved PnC, we have completely reworked the first part of the game.
Many dialogues have been changed, and part of the storyline as well!

As I mentioned in previous news, we had to make some adjustments to better align with our new vision for the game.
But don’t worry—everything we originally planned is still there! The different romances, the intrigues, and the overall storyline remain the same in broad strokes. However, some details, like Daisy’s relationship with the player, had to be adjusted.
(And personally, I like it much more now!)

We’ve also fixed a lot of bugs and completely revamped the save system. So, between the updated story and the recoded save system, old saves will no longer work!
Now is the perfect time to start a new game!
This shouldn’t happen again in the future, but this change was really necessary.
[h3][b]
About the next update: Part 2[/b][/h3]

Well, it’s already finished and will be available on Steam in four weeks!
We’re already working on the next one—Part 3 (Yes, I know, we’re efficient! 😉)

If you have any feedback, whether it’s about bugs or just to share your thoughts on the game, feel free to comment on this post or on the Steam forums—I’ll be happy to reply!

Enjoy the game, and see you soon!
Salty

notes.title: "PORN and CARDS" Yes, we change the name.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
First small update today with quite a few fixes added to the game.

And most importantly, as you may have noticed, the game has changed its name!

Goodbye [strike]Love and Cards[/strike] hello [b]Porn and Cards[/b]!~~

We've decided to focus more on the NSFW aspect, so the game now includes the NSFW version by default! No need for an extra DLC anymore~

(The game will still have both an erotic version and an adult version, because I really like the erotic mode—I think it's cool—but no more censored version.)

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3017700/extras/lncgif04.gif?t=1738336641[/img]

By the way, the next big update (Part 2) is currently in development!
We're aiming for a release at the end of February! Stay tuned for upcoming announcements! ~~

Also, you’ll see in the game menu a mention of a comic we are working on!
I’ll probably make a news post to talk more about it in detail, but go check it out on our social networks!

And finally, here is the changelog for this update!
See you later ~~

notes.title: Love & Cards Early Access OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!
Our new game "[b]Love & Cards[/b]" is now available in Early Access![/h2]

[i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3017700/Love__Cards/[/url][/b][/i]

Set in the same universe as OPT 1 & 2, this new game introduces you to brand-new characters and adventures on the planet New Frontier!
This game is a mix of a visual novel, a card game, a point-and-click, and a romance game! (Yes, a lot all at once!)

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44891385/7cb41f24648a4cdb680f9350fb0df1fe100cae7e.png[/img]

In this first update, which offers nearly an hour of content, you’ll get to experience all the new features we’ve added to the game: improved graphics, more animations, voice-acted dialogues, and much more advanced storytelling than before!

I wish you all an amazing time playing! Don’t hesitate to leave a positive review if you enjoyed it (it helps a lot)!
And most importantly, share your feedback with us! Our goal is to create the best game possible!

Have a great day, everyone!
Bye ~~
